mapper.insert: insert into copilot_usage_log (feature, site_code, ref_id, model, status, input_tokens, output_tokens, latency_ms, error, operator, create_time) values (#{feature}, #{siteCode}, #{refId}, #{model}, #{status}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{latencyMs}, #{error}, #{operator}, localtimestamp)
mapper.select: select count(*) from copilot_usage_log where feature = #{feature} and create_time >= current_date
select count(*) from copilot_usage_log where feature = #{feature} and operator = #{operator} and create_time >= current_date
